# ReflexGrid

> Open-source, self-hosted online Excel: a browser spreadsheet that opens and saves real .xlsx and .xlsm workbooks, runs their Excel VBA macros and UserForms, and lets several people edit the same workbook live. A pure-Python spreadsheet engine (gridcore) with a Reflex web app. MIT license.

- Excel VBA macros in the browser: a VBA editor, MsgBox and InputBox dialogs, event macros (Worksheet_Change, Workbook_Open…), VBA functions in formulas, and UserForms (modal and modeless) with a form designer. Macros run on the server in a sandbox: no files, shell, network or COM.
- Checked against Microsoft Excel: 457 VBA language and library cases, 158 object-model scenarios, and files Excel opens, saves and ReflexGrid recalculates to Excel's results.
- Third-party VBA runs too: the published spec workbook of VBA-JSON (MIT, written for Excel by its authors) runs its own suite in ReflexGrid, with the result in the compatibility report. Conditional compilation (#If VBA7/Win64/Mac, #Const) is supported.
- Excel for the web can't run VBA, ONLYOFFICE runs JavaScript macros only, and Collabora Online runs part of VBA with macros off by default. ReflexGrid runs VBA itself, UserForms included.
- AI that asks first (with the AI Hub of re_ddns): an assistant changes cells, VBA code and UserForms; each change waits for Accept, shows as the AI's for everyone, and one click takes it back; Claude or a local model
- Real-time collaboration: shared links, presence, everyone's selection, per-person undo; workbooks are saved on the server as .xlsx (.xlsm with macros).
- gridcore works without the UI: 479 worksheet functions, dynamic arrays, LET/LAMBDA, structured references, incremental recalculation; reads and writes .xlsx, .xlsm, .csv; runs VBA macros headless, with no Excel installed (`Session().run("macro.run", name="Main")`, or `python -m gridcore.cli run book.xlsm script.json`).
- Install: clone reflex_grid and reflex_ddns_auth side by side, then `poetry install` and `poetry run ./reflex_rerun.sh` (Python 3.11 or newer).

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/milochen0418/reflex_grid/main/README.md): features, comparison with other web spreadsheets, FAQ, install, Python API and command line
- [Excel macros (VBA)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/milochen0418/reflex_grid/main/docs/vba.md): design, sandbox, checks against Excel, supported language and object model, limits
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/milochen0418/reflex_grid/main/docs/architecture.md): engine layers, commands, undo, recalculation, collaboration
- [Excel compatibility report](https://milochen0418.github.io/reflex_grid/compatibility.html): the latest automated test results by area, compared with answers recorded from Microsoft Excel, and the checks run in Microsoft Excel itself
- [Excel compatibility report as JSON](https://milochen0418.github.io/reflex_grid/compatibility.json): the same report as data
- [Checks in Microsoft Excel (JSON)](https://milochen0418.github.io/reflex_grid/excel-oracle.json): each check's result, every difference, the Excel version and commit
